title: Data Inspector
tagline: A tiny game about clean data, by PostHog

music.mood: calm, focused, ticking clock, office bureaucracy

text.win: Five days, zero garbage. The dashboards finally tell the truth.
text.lose: Bad data slipped into the dashboards. Nobody trusts the numbers now. Try again?
text.credits: Made with PostHog. Music and art generated locally.

days.intro: Welcome aboard! Only let in events from our tracking plan. Typos break every dashboard.

rules.text: Flag events that aren't in the tracking plan

days.intro: Someone left staging pointed at production again. Keep test traffic out.

rules.text: Flag events from staging or localhost

days.intro: Our own team keeps clicking around in prod. Their events skew everything.

rules.text: Flag events from our own team's emails
Every event with a plan must have its plan

days.intro: Finance says revenue looks weird. Watch the invoice amounts and the clocks.

rules.text: Flag events stamped in the future

days.intro: Last day before the board meeting. Plans must be real, and no double counting!

rules.text: plan must be free, pro or team
Flag IDs you've already seen today

final_record.intro: One last record before the board meeting. It looks fine. Does it, though?
